research_findings.title: Calibration-First Model Selection Yields +34.69% ROI vs -35.17% ROI (accuracy-based) on NBA Data
research_findings.source: Wang et al. arxiv 2303.06021 — cited in 2025 literature
research_findings.key_insight: Isotonic regression post-processing as model selection criterion dramatically outperforms accuracy-based selection for NBA betting ROI. Tree ensembles (Extra Trees) benefit most from post-hoc calibration. scikit-learn 1.8 adds temperature scaling (preferred when calibration samples < 2000). Current S10 optimizing Brier is calibration-aligned — good. S11 experiments should explicitly use CalibratedClassifierCV with isotonic method.

research_findings.title: Adaptive Conformal Inference via Coin Betting — Parameter-Free, Distribution-Shift Robust Coverage
research_findings.key_insight: New adaptive conformal inference eliminates learning-rate hyperparameter — easy to implement, valid coverage under non-stationary conditions (roster changes mid-season). Ensemble score aggregation reduces prediction set conservatism. Neither requires retraining. High-value add for prediction interval generation on top of current Brier-optimized models.

research_findings.title: GA Mutation ~0.20 Outperforms Lower Rates for Feature Selection; Pop 10-50 Sufficient
research_findings.key_insight: Empirical: mutation rate ~0.20 prevents premature convergence better than 0.05-0.10 in sports betting GA implementations. However, S10's proven optimal is 0.09 from 1244 experiments — trust system data over generic finding. Pop 10-50 sufficient for feature selection (S10 already at 60). Warning: always hold out test set to detect overfitting.
